title: High-resolution mapping of global surface water and its long-term changes
authors: Jean-François Pekel; Andrew Cottam; Noel Gorelick; Alan S. Belward
importance: Foundational global surface-water mapping reference; establishes a long temporal Landsat baseline and the JRC Global Surface Water product.
evidence_note: Direct EO observation of surface-water occurrence/change; must not be generalized to groundwater presence.

title: Analysis of methods used to validate remote sensing and GIS-based groundwater potential maps in the last two decades: A review
importance: Reviews 125 studies and makes validation quality a central issue; field data reflecting aquifer productivity are preferable validation evidence.
evidence_note: Groundwater-potential maps are indirect inference products and require field/hydrogeologic validation.

title: Groundwater Potential Mapping Using Machine Learning Techniques: Current Trends and Future Perspectives
importance: Recent synthesis emphasizing explainability, uncertainty, multi-source integration and transferability as research gaps.
evidence_note: Useful state-of-the-art map; quality depends on validation and regional transfer.

title: Groundwater inverse modeling: Physics-informed neural network with disentangled constraints and errors
authors: Yuzhe Ji; Yuanyuan Zha; Tian-Chyi J. Yeh; Liangsheng Shi; Yanling Wang
importance: Concrete physics-informed inverse-modeling route: estimates hydraulic conductivity using a PINN plus Karhunen–Loève expansion.
evidence_note: Physics-informed inference concerns subsurface flow/parameters, not direct satellite detection of groundwater.

title: Geologic remote sensing for geothermal exploration: A review
authors: Freek van der Meer; Christoph Hecker; Frank van Ruitenbeek; Harald van der Werff; Charlotte de Wijkerslooth; Carolina Wechsler
importance: Foundational review connecting SWIR alteration mineralogy, TIR temperature/heat flux and InSAR deformation with geothermal exploration.
evidence_note: Remote-sensing observables are exploration evidence/proxies, not reservoir confirmation.

title: Advances in geothermal energy prospectivity mapping research based on machine learning in the age of big data
authors: Yongyi Li; Ghaffar Ali; Abdul Rehman Akbar
importance: Maps the transition from conventional prospectivity mapping to ML-enhanced play fairway analysis.
evidence_note: Useful methodology bridge from expert weighting to data-driven models.

title: Review on geothermal prospectivity mapping: Global trends, challenges, and future directions
authors: Ahmad Ibrahim Aliyu; Haylay Tsegab Gebretsadik; James Olosegbuwa Egbokhare; Mushtaq Ahmad; Abdulrasheed Ibrahim Yerima; Asmau Iyabo Balogun
importance: Current global review (~100 studies); highlights hybrid expert+statistical+ensemble approaches, XAI and uncertainty as frontier issues.
evidence_note: Strong frontier anchor for research gaps and validation design.

title: Advances in Thermal Infrared Remote Sensing Technology for Geothermal Resource Detection
importance: Modern TIR-focused review; stresses integration with geology, geophysics and geochemistry.
evidence_note: Thermal anomalies are surface evidence and require target-specific corroboration.

title: Early-phase geothermal prospecting using remote sensing and machine learning: application to Buharkent and Germencik fields, Türkiye
authors: Hakan Oktay Aydınlı; Gordana Kaplan; Saye Nihan Çabuk
importance: Recent application using LST, lineament density, hydrothermal alteration, K-means and Random Forest in mature geothermal fields.
evidence_note: Supports remote sensing as an early exploration/support tool, not standalone reservoir proof.

title: The Geothermal Artificial Intelligence for geothermal exploration
importance: Integrates geological/geophysical information and remote-sensing indicators in an AI geothermal exploration framework.

title: Evaluating the Efficiency of Machine Learning Algorithms in Identifying Geothermal Energy Potential Areas in Akita and Iwate Provinces, Japan
authors: Majid Kiavarz; Mohammadreza Jelokhani-Niaraki; Avin Meysami; Yasaman Ghorbani; Najmeh Neysani Samany
importance: Very recent ML application under limited well data; useful for data-scarcity and validation discussions.
evidence_note: Useful contemporary case, but reported accuracy should be interpreted with sampling/validation design in mind.

title: Prithvi-EO-2.0: A Versatile Multi-Temporal Foundation Model for Earth Observation Applications
authors: Daniela Szwarcman; Sujit Roy; Paolo Fraccaro; et al.
importance: Strong open EO foundation model: 300M/600M models trained on 4.2M global HLS time-series samples with temporal/location embeddings.
evidence_note: Highly actionable for downstream fine-tuning and benchmark comparisons.

title: TerraMind: Large-Scale Generative Multimodality for Earth Observation
authors: Johannes Jakubik; Felix Yang; Benedikt Blumenstiel; et al.
importance: Any-to-any generative multimodal EO foundation model trained across nine modalities; introduces Thinking-in-Modalities.
evidence_note: Especially relevant for optical+SAR/multimodal research hypotheses.

title: SatMAE: Pre-training Transformers for Temporal and Multi-Spectral Satellite Imagery
authors: Yezhen Cong; Samar Khanna; Chenlin Meng; Patrick Liu; Erik Rozi; Yutong He; Marshall Burke; David B. Lobell; Stefano Ermon
importance: Seminal EO masked-autoencoder work explicitly modeling temporal and multispectral satellite structure.
evidence_note: Foundational precursor for later EO foundation models.

title: Foundation Models for Remote Sensing and Earth Observation: A Survey
authors: Aoran Xiao; Weihao Xuan; Junjue Wang; Jiaxing Huang; Dacheng Tao; Shijian Lu; Naoto Yokoya
importance: Broad taxonomy and benchmark-oriented survey spanning visual, vision-language and other RS foundation models.
evidence_note: Excellent snowballing root for the foundation-model branch.

title: Vision Foundation Models in Remote Sensing: A Survey
authors: Siqi Lu; Junlin Guo; James R Zimmer-Dauphinee; et al.
importance: Complementary survey of vision foundation models, pretraining datasets and transfer/generalization issues.
evidence_note: Useful for model-family comparison and research-gap triangulation.

title: The Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 Version 2.0 Surface Reflectance Dataset
authors: J. Ju; Q. Zhou; B. Freitag; D. P. Roy; H. K. Zhang; M. Sridhar; et al.
importance: Analysis-ready harmonized Landsat/Sentinel-2 dataset underpinning Prithvi-EO-2.0 and many temporal EO workflows.
evidence_note: Important data foundation for reproducible temporal EO experiments.

title: NASA-IMPACT/Prithvi-EO-2.0
importance: Official code/examples for Prithvi-EO-2.0 fine-tuning.

title: IBM/terramind
importance: Official TerraMind code examples, generation and fine-tuning.

title: Clay Foundation Model
importance: Open EO foundation model with geospatial/temporal context and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2/DEM-oriented workflows.

title: DOFA: Dynamic One-For-All Foundation Model
importance: Unified EO model designed to handle arbitrary channel counts and multiple sensor modalities.

title: sustainlab-group/SatMAE
importance: Official SatMAE code for temporal and multispectral masked-autoencoder pretraining.

title: TerraTorch
importance: Fine-tuning framework for geospatial foundation models; integrates with TorchGeo and multiple model families.

title: TorchGeo
importance: PyTorch geospatial datasets, samplers, transforms and pretrained models; strong implementation substrate.

title: segment-geospatial (SamGeo)
authors: Qiusheng Wu; Lucas Prado Osco; contributors
importance: Practical geospatial SAM tooling for raster/vector segmentation and interactive workflows.

title: allenai/satlas
importance: Satlas geospatial data plus SatlasPretrain dataset/model resources.

title: allenai/satlaspretrain_models
importance: Pretrained models for Sentinel-1/2, Landsat and aerial imagery.

title: JRC Global Surface Water Mapping Layers v1.4
importance: Global 30 m surface-water occurrence/change layers derived from 4.7M+ Landsat scenes through 2021.

title: Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 v2.0 (HLS)
importance: Analysis-ready harmonized Landsat/Sentinel-2 surface reflectance with frequent revisit; core pretraining source for Prithvi-EO-2.0.

title: Landsat Collection 2 Surface Reflectance
importance: Core 30 m analysis-ready optical record used broadly for long-term surface-water and geothermal studies.

title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI products
importance: 10–60 m multispectral data with Level-1C/Level-2A products; central optical source for water, alteration and EO FM research.

title: BigEarthNet v2.0
importance: Large-scale Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 benchmark with current v2.0 releases; useful for multimodal EO representation learning.

title: BigEarthNet.txt
authors: Johann-Ludwig Herzog; Mathis Jürgen Adler; et al.
importance: 2026 multi-sensor image-text benchmark: ~464k co-registered S1/S2 images and ~9.6M S1-S2-text triplets.

title: USGS Geothermal Data Releases
importance: Official geothermal data releases including magnetotellurics, resource favorability and geochemical/hydrologic data.

title: NetworkX MultiDiGraph documentation
importance: Supports directed graphs with parallel edges, matching qualified scientific relations in the V1 design.

title: PyVis documentation
importance: Interactive HTML network visualization with NetworkX integration; suitable as a derived V1 view.

title: Pydantic JSON Schema documentation
importance: Typed validation plus standards-compliant JSON Schema generation for scientific records.

title: SQLite FTS5 Extension
importance: Local deterministic full-text search layer appropriate for a rebuildable V1 index.

title: OpenAlex API / Help
importance: Open scholarly graph for works, authors, institutions and citations; useful for forward/backward expansion.

title: Crossref REST API
importance: Canonical DOI metadata retrieval and normalization.

title: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
importance: Paper/citation graph API useful as a complementary discovery source.

title: Citation Style Language specification
importance: Interoperable citation/bibliography representation supporting the DESIGN choice of generated CSL-JSON.
